description: Two function generators, each also a slew limiter and an envelope follower, feeding four attenuverter channels and a mixing bus that sums, inverts and takes the maximum

params.text: An attenuverter on that generator's output, silent at centre, full level clockwise and full level inverted anticlockwise; it feeds the numbered output below it and the mixing bus
Latches that channel into free running, so it retriggers itself the moment the fall ends; the lamp beside it is lit while looping
Sets how long that channel's rise takes, from a tenth of a millisecond at the far left to 1500 seconds at the far right
An attenuverter on IN 2, silent at centre, full level clockwise and inverted anticlockwise; with IN 2 unpatched it scales a fixed 10V, giving a manual offset from -10V to +10V
Sets how long that channel's fall takes, from a tenth of a millisecond at the far left to 1500 seconds at the far right
An attenuverter on IN 3, silent at centre, full level clockwise and inverted anticlockwise; with IN 3 unpatched it scales a fixed 5V, giving a manual offset from -5V to +5V
Bends both slopes of that channel: logarithmic at the far left, linear a third of the way up, exponential at the far right; the left half also stretches the stage times, the right half shortens them
Picks how CURVE is applied to that channel: Shark Fin bends the rise and the fall in opposite directions, Mirror bends both the same way, and Mirror is the position it starts in

inputs.text: A signal for that channel to slew; while the generator is idle the channel tracks this voltage at the rates set by SURGE and SINK, and while a cycle is running it is folded in gently instead
A rising edge above 1V starts a fresh rise on that channel; an edge during the rise is ignored, and one during the fall drops the output to 0V and restarts
A signal scaled by the attenuverter above it and sent to output 2 and the mixing bus; with nothing patched the channel reads a fixed 10V
A signal scaled by the attenuverter above it and sent to output 3 and the mixing bus; with nothing patched the channel reads a fixed 5V
Lengthens that channel's rise by half an octave of time per volt, and shortens it for negative voltage, over a span of twelve octaves either way
Scales the rise and the fall of that channel together, positive voltage making the whole cycle faster and negative voltage slower
Lengthens that channel's fall by half an octave of time per volt, and shortens it for negative voltage, over a span of twelve octaves either way
A voltage above 2.5V puts that channel into free running for as long as it is held, whatever the LOOP button is set to

outputs.text: That generator's output scaled by the attenuverter above it, clamped to ±10V; patching this jack takes the channel out of the OR, SUM and INV bus
IN 2 scaled by the attenuverter above it, clamped to ±10V; patching this jack takes the channel out of the OR, SUM and INV bus
IN 3 scaled by the attenuverter above it, clamped to ±10V; patching this jack takes the channel out of the OR, SUM and INV bus
A 10V gate on channel 1, going high at the top of the rise and staying high for the whole of the fall; with IN 1 patched and no cycle running it is high while the slew falls
That generator's output at full level, ahead of its attenuverter, swinging from 0V to 10.2V
The highest of the four channel voltages after their attenuverters, floored at 0V and clamped to 10V, counting only channels whose numbered output is unpatched
The four channel voltages after their attenuverters added together and clamped to ±10V, counting only channels whose numbered output is unpatched
The SUM voltage with its sign flipped, clamped to ±10V
A 10V gate on channel 4, high for the whole of the rise; with IN 4 patched and no cycle running it is high while the slew rises

notes: both attenuverters start at centre, where they pass nothing, so the numbered outputs and the mixing bus are silent until you turn one of them away from noon
the two dark rectangles draw the shape of each channel's cycle, with a dot running along it while the channel is active; nothing on them can be clicked or dragged
a channel with nothing patched into its signal or trigger jack and its LOOP button off holds at 0V; it needs a trigger, a loop or a patched signal before it puts anything out
menu: Bandlimited EOR/EOC — smooths the edges of the EoR and EoC gates so they alias less at audio rates
Bandlimited CH1/CH4 Signal Outputs — smooths the jump the generator makes when a fall reaches the bottom, so the output aliases less at audio rates
Preview Tracer — draws a moving dot on each channel's curve display showing where that channel is in its cycle
Interpolate Timing Updates — spreads a change of rise or fall time across the samples between timing updates, removing the zipper tone heavy modulation otherwise causes
Timing Update Rate — sets how often the rise and fall times are recalculated from the knobs and the CV, at audio rate or one sample in four, eight, sixteen or thirty-two
Force Halo Dynamic Surface to NanoVG — draws the lit rings around the knobs without OpenGL
